name: nxt
description: nxt — live niche trends intelligence for dropshipping

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently -k -n server,client -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: node init && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.start: node init && npm run start -w server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client
